resources.string: You don\'t need to sign in to change the name. If the session has dropped, you can sign in again below.
Choose a provider, then sign in with your email on that provider\'s own sign-in page. The app never sees your password; only session cookies are stored encrypted on your device.
Output: the zip produced by Claude is downloaded and unpacked; if no zip arrives, code blocks are used.
Output: the file/zip produced by ChatGPT is downloaded; if none arrives, code blocks are used.

Output: a long code block; if the reply is cut off, \"continue\" is sent automatically. Kimi\'s sign-in page offers phone, Google, or SSO (no email). You can try \"Continue with Google\"; if Google rejects in-app sign-in, use phone sign-in or an API key.
Output: the Gemini web interface is not used. You get an API key from Google AI Studio in your phone\'s browser and paste it here; outputs are produced with the official API.
Using a Claude web account automatically with this app violates Anthropic\'s terms of use. Your account may be restricted or closed without notice. Only add accounts you can afford to lose.

Automating actions with your Google account may be considered a violation of Google\'s terms, and your account may be restricted or closed. Don\'t use your main Google account; use one you can afford to lose.
I understand the risk and add it at my own responsibility
Sign in on the page. You can try \"Continue with Google\" directly; if Google rejects in-app sign-in, a warning appears. When the chat screen shows up, tap \"I\'ve finished signing in\" at the top.
Google rejected sign-in in this window (Google blocks in-app browsers; the app can\'t get around this). Sign in with a phone number, or add Kimi with an API key.
Kimi allows sign-in with phone, Google, or SSO; there is no email option.
Google doesn\'t allow sign-in from within an app. Tap \"Open in browser\", sign in with your Google account, create a key with \"Create API key\", copy it, and paste it below.
No key found on the page. Create the key first or paste it manually.
The key was not accepted by Gemini.
No session found. Finish signing in and try again.

In your phone\'s browser (Chrome), sign in to kimi.com with Google or phone. Then copy the script below, paste it into the address bar and type \"javascript:\" at the START by hand (Chrome strips that part when pasting). Copy all of the text in the box that appears and paste it below. Note: if Kimi doesn\'t keep the session in these records, this route won\'t work; use an API key then.
